# Form Conventions

Keep labels visible. Place helper text below the field it explains.

<DoDont
  doText="Use Save billing address"
  dontText="Use Submit"
/>

```mdx
<DoDont
  doText="This fenced DoDont must stay out"
  dontText="This fenced DoDont must stay out"
/>
```

````mdx
```mdx
- This nested fenced item must stay out
<DoDont doText="This nested fenced DoDont must stay out" dontText="This nested fenced DoDont must stay out" />
```
````

Use action labels that name the object, such as "Save billing address".

## Do

- Keep labels visible after the field has a value.
- Place helper text below the field it explains.

```markdown
- This fenced example must stay out of structured handoff data.
```

## Do not

- Replace specific action labels with Submit.
- Hide required-field state behind color alone.

## Accessibility

- Keep every input associated with a visible label.
- Announce validation errors next to the field that caused them.

### Keyboard

- Preserve tab order from top to bottom.

## Migration

- Replace placeholder-only labels with persistent label text.
- Replace generic submit actions with object-specific actions.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string | yes | - | Visible field label. |
| helperText | string | no | - | Extra guidance shown below the field. |
| size | "sm" \| "md" | no | "md" | Controls field density. |

Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description
--- | --- | --- | --- | ---
errorText | string | no | - | Validation message shown below the field.

```markdown
| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ghost | string | yes | - | This fenced table must stay out. |
```
